project_description: Operators and internal hosts have a merged usage-record billing engine but cannot turn it on from stock composition. Today lipstd and public lipruntime.Options do not invent billing accounts or open the Bun journal; RatingResolver exists only as test fakes; holds store snapshot refs without a catalog; account create and funding are store methods with read-only admin reports. This spec adds the host-composition path: identity mapping from authenticated principal/session, journal open plus admission adapter wiring through existing BuildHost ProductionOptions, an immutable versioned pricing/policy/operator-rate catalog with a stock RatingResolver, and trusted account provisioning (create/fund/credit-policy), without reopening stream, routing, TUR sealing, or public lipruntime.Options money fields unless explicitly required.
